title: Hearty Tunisian Bryndza Stir-fry
description: A warm, tangy stir‑fry that blends sharp bryndza with bell pepper, tomato, and cumin, finished in a molcajete for a rustic finish. This dish is both energizing and kosher-friendly, making it a perfect dinner option.
instructions: Heat a wok over medium-high heat and add olive oil.
Add chopped onion and sauté until translucent.
Stir in minced garlic, ground cumin, coriander, and harissa paste; cook for 1 minute.
Add diced bell pepper and tomato, stir-fry for 5 minutes until softened.
Sprinkle salt and pepper, stir well.
Reduce heat to medium, crumble bryndza into the wok, cook for 3 minutes until cheese melts slightly.
Transfer the mixture into a preheated molcajete and crush gently with a wooden spoon to combine flavors.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
